answer: Anchor identity in a bonded work trail: every agent locks a refundable stake before taking paid jobs, and each job mints a signed receipt chained into a public ledger - an onyx-hard record that cannot be quietly rewritten. An honest agent stakes once (a walnut-sized deposit) and reuses it across jobs, so the real cost is near zero. A Sybil operator must fund a separate stake per fake identity and fabricate a full receipt trail for each, like milling timber one log at a time - faking at scale costs as much as real work, making mass fakes unprofitable.
